description_en: Queries the details of session instances in a delivery group, including instance ID, instance status, creation time, update time, session status, and public IP address of the primary network interface
description_zh: 查询交付组内会话实例的详细信息，包括实例ID、实例状态、创建时间、更新时间、会话状态、主网卡公网IP等
name: ListAppInstances

parameters.help_en: The list of application instance statuses
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The list of application instance IDs. Maximum length: 100
parameters.help_zh: 应用实例ID列表，最大长度为100
parameters.name: app_instance_id_list

parameters.help_en: The number of query results per page. Maximum value: `100`. Default value: `20`. Specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 每页的查询结果数量，不可超过`100`。默认值为`20`。建议填写该参数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the query results to display. Default value: `1`. Specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 需展示的查询结果页码。默认值为`1`。建议填写该参数
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to query information about deleted instances. If this parameter is set to true, the AppInstanceIdList parameter is required. Otherwise, a parameter error is returned
parameters.help_zh:
是否查询已删除的实例信息。
该参数为true时AppInstanceIdList的字段必填，否则会报参数错误
parameters.name: include_deleted

parameters.help_en: The list of user IDs. Maximum length: 100
parameters.name: user_id_list

AppInstanceModels.description_en: The list of queried application instances

BindInfo.description_en: The binding information between the instance and the user
BindInfo.description_zh: 实例与用户绑定相关信息

EndUserId.description_en: The end user ID bound to the instance

UsageDuration.description_en: The usage duration of the instance. Unit: seconds

ChargeType.description_en:
The billing type of the instance. Valid values:
PrePaid: subscription (prepaid).
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go (postpaid).
This parameter is returned only when the billing mode of the delivery group to which this instance belongs is resource-based billing (ChargeResourceMode=Node)
ChargeType.description_zh:
实例的付费类型，返回值：
PrePaid：包年包月（预付费）。
PostPaid：按量付费（后付费）。
只有本实例所属交付组的售卖模式为按资源售卖（ChargeResourceMode=Node）时，才会返回本参数

MainEthPublicIp.description_en: The public IP address of the primary network interface controller (NIC). This value is returned only when the network policy (`StrategyType`) of the delivery group is set to mixed mode pattern (`Mixed`). Otherwise, this value is empty
MainEthPublicIp.description_zh: 主网卡公网IP。交付组网络策略（`StrategyType`）为混合模式（`Mixed`）时才返回该值，否则为空

NodeId.description_en:
The ID of the node on which the instance runs.
This parameter is returned only when the billing mode of the delivery group to which this instance belongs is resource-based billing (ChargeResourceMode=Node)
NodeId.description_zh:
运行实例的节点ID。
只有本实例所属交付组的售卖模式为按资源售卖（ChargeResourceMode=Node）时，才会返回本参数

SessionStatus.description_en: The session connection status. This value is returned only when the instance status is running (`RUNNING`). Otherwise, this value is empty
SessionStatus.description_zh: 会话连接状态。实例状态为应用运行中（`RUNNING`）时才返回该值，否则为空

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the query results to display. Specify this parameter
PageNumber.description_zh: 需展示的查询结果页码。建议填写该参数

PageSize.description_en: The number of query results per page. Maximum value: `100`. Specify this parameter
PageSize.description_zh: 每页的查询结果数量，不可超过`100`。建议填写该参数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of query results
